implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromes in a given text file
implemented_requirements.evidence: def find_palindromes(path: str): ... uses is_palindrome() on each line and each word, returning lists of palindrome words and palindrome lines.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a command‑line interface to specify the input file (defaulting to "input.txt")
implemented_requirements.evidence: def main(argv): path = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "input.txt"; file existence check; prints results.

judge.summary: The script reads a text file, normalizes text to ignore case and non‑alphanumeric characters, and correctly identifies both palindrome words and whole palindrome lines. It includes a usable CLI, handles missing files gracefully, and contains no apparent runtime errors, satisfying the benchmark requirement.
